$comment: Lane 2 (plan 09 §5.2; plan 10 A11a): model-graded cases, run by hand before a release on the fixture manual league. `fixture_variant` names the per-case variant of fixtures/manual/ that the eval runner layers on the base league; `setup` says what it must contain. Expectation kinds: skills/README.md#lane-2-cases.

cases.prompt: Should I start Jaxon Smith-Njigba or Keenan Allen at flex?
cases.setup: Week 4, no slot locked. The variant adds { week: 4, team: 2 } to opponents, so Team B's roster is this week's opponent; Team A is the projected favourite (mu_m > mu_o). Jaxon Smith-Njigba (W/R/T) and Keenan Allen (BN) are the pair; Keenan Allen is the higher-floor option.

expectations.text: Names protect or chase and gives the one-line reason (Team A is ahead on projection, so the floor matters more than the ceiling).

cases.prompt: Kenneth Walker III or Derrick Henry at RB2?
cases.setup: Team B is this week's opponent (opponents week 4) and Team A is a 9-point projected underdog. Derrick Henry (RB) has the higher ceiling (p90); Kenneth Walker III (BN) the higher mean by less than one point.

expectations.text: Recommends the higher-variance option or explains why not, citing the underdog status; reports the swap as a coin flip if coin_flip is true rather than dramatising it.

cases.prompt: Trey McBride is Questionable. Do I start him or Hunter Henry?
cases.setup: Trey McBride (ARI) is Questionable with a limited-practice trend; his game kicks off at 16:25 ET. Hunter Henry (NE) plays at 13:00 ET, so choosing McBride means Henry's slot locks first.

expectations.text: Uses p_active (about 71 % for Questionable), not a coin toss; names the commitment problem (Henry's 13:00 game locks before McBride's status is final) and gives a conditional line.

cases.prompt: My buddy texted that Jahmyr Gibbs is out. Who replaces him?
cases.setup: Base league, week 4, no slot locked. Nothing in the injury data says Gibbs is out.

expectations.text: Treats the text as an unconfirmed claim, quotes it rather than acting on it, says what would confirm it (the official report, the app's status), and gives a conditional lineup rather than benching Gibbs outright.

cases.prompt: Jaxon Smith-Njigba is inactive, who do I put in?
cases.setup: Two slots (the QB and one WR) have locked; Jaxon Smith-Njigba (W/R/T) and the bench receiver Keenan Allen play later games. There is no game-day availability source under the manual league.

expectations.text: Offers only replacements whose slots are still unlocked; says there is no game-day availability source in this version and makes the swap conditional on the fantasy app showing Smith-Njigba as Out or Inactive; never suggests moving a locked player.

cases.setup: Every starter and bench player's game has kicked off.

expectations.text: Says nothing is actionable because every slot is locked, without inventing a move.

cases.prompt: what are my odds right now?
cases.setup: Some games final, some live, some pending; opponent roster present. Live win probability (ff_analyze_matchup mode live) is Phase 2.

expectations.text: Says live odds are not available in this version and, when it gives a number, labels it the pre-game win probability; treats in-game scores as provisional. (Phase 2: expects final/live/pending from ff_analyze_matchup mode live instead.)

cases.prompt: Should I start Jaxon Smith-Njigba or Keenan Allen at flex?
cases.setup: Week 4, no slot locked, Team B entered as the opponent. The variant republishes the schedule with SEA's week-4 game flexed from Sunday 16:05 ET to Sunday 20:20 ET two days ago, so ff_get_status lists it under schedule.recent_changes and ff_get_roster, ff_project_players and ff_analyze_lineup each carry the kickoff-change warning; every lock_at already uses the new kickoff.

expectations.text: Opens with the moved kickoff and Jaxon Smith-Njigba's new lock time in ET before the lineup, never quotes the old 16:05 ET lock, gives the deadline as the earliest lock among the players moved, and says to ask again in the final 90 minutes before it.

cases.prompt: Who should I start this week?
cases.setup: Clock in week 1 of a new NFL season, before the first injury report: ff_get_status shows nflverse:injuries as not_published (checked an hour ago) and season.not_published lists it; ff_project_players and ff_analyze_lineup answer with the named assumption that no injury report for the season is published upstream yet.

expectations.text: Says the season's injury report is not published upstream yet and that this is the data provider's state, not a fault; gives the lineup with that assumption named under Confidence & freshness; never asks the user to run ff refresh (all or any source) and never retries in a loop.

cases.setup: The league file names the previous season; the clock is in the next NFL season's preseason, so ff_get_status shows season.league_matches false with league_season one behind nfl_season, and the analytics tools add the league-season warning.

expectations.text: Before any lineup advice, names both seasons (the league file's and the NFL's), says the advice would describe the old season until the file is updated, and offers the onboard Skill's new-season step; changes nothing and writes no file.
